content: To create a Resident Survival Guide page, follow these detailed instructions: 1. Creating a New Page: Begin by creating a new page on Wikidoc. The process is straightforward and user-friendly. For detailed guidance on how to create a new page, refer to the instructions provided on the designated page. The Resident Survival Guide page should include the following sections: Overview Causes Life-Threatening Causes Common Causes Management References 2. Adhering to the Template: It is essential to follow the standardized design for a Resident Survival Guide page. You can access the template through the navigation link provided on the relevant page. 3. Exclusion of the Microchapters Navigation Bar: While designing the algorithm, the microchapters navigation bar on the right side of the page should not be included. This decision allows editors to utilize the full width of the page, providing ample space to create a detailed and comprehensive algorithm. 4. Designing an Algorithm: When you click the edit button, you will be directed to the editing page, which contains the symbols and structure necessary to design the algorithm. Follow the established design and structure of the algorithm until you achieve the desired format. Wikidoc offers guidance and support during the training period to help you refine your algorithm design. Examples of algorithms summarizing specific approaches are available for reference. 5. Adding a Link to the Main Page: For instance, if you are working on a Resident Survival Guide for hyperkalemia, include a link to the guide on the hyperkalemia page. To create the link, use the following format: Type the appropriate text or code, and it will generate the desired link or animated picture.
